name: Codex
removalRules: Archived and inactive sessions require deletion review. Active sessions and other storage stay protected. Linked Git worktrees retain their review controls.

storage.name: Codex sessions
storage.explanation: Saved conversations and task history. Use Codex to manage these files.

storage.name: Codex archived sessions
storage.explanation: Archived conversations can contain task history. Use Codex to manage these files.

storage.name: Codex attachments
storage.explanation: Files attached to tasks. These files can be the only local copies.

storage.name: Codex generated images
storage.explanation: Images created in tasks. These files can be the only local copies.

storage.name: Codex memories
storage.explanation: Persistent memories and supporting files remain protected. Session deletion does not select this folder.

storage.name: Codex plugins
storage.explanation: Installed plugins and their files. Use Codex to manage plugins.

storage.name: Codex other cache files
storage.explanation: The folder name does not prove that removal is safe. Moppo keeps these files protected.

storage.name: Codex temporary files
storage.explanation: These files can belong to active tasks. Moppo keeps them protected.

section.summary: Downloaded runtimes used to run tasks.
